description: This file defines the Review controller class within the Opencart e-commerce platform. It handles the process of sending email notifications when a product review is submitted, including retrieving product info, composing email data, and creating tasks for email dispatch.

classes.name: Review
classes.description: A controller class responsible for handling review-related email notifications within the Opencart platform.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method triggered after a review is added; it checks configuration, loads necessary data, and creates email tasks to notify configured recipients about the new review.
